import sys

def init(x, l, k, p, c, s):
    c[k][l] += 1
    s[k][l][c[k][l]] = p[0] - x
    p[0] += 1
    if l == k:
        return
    for i in range(10):
        init(x * 10 + i, l + 1, k, p, c, s)

def brute(x, l, n, p, ans):
    if x > n:
        return
    p[0] += 1
    ans[0] = (ans[0] + (p[0] - x) // V - (p[0] < x) + X) % X
    for i in range(10):
        brute(x * 10 + i, l + 1, n, p, ans)

def lower_bound(arr, start, end, v):
    # Binary search for v in arr[start:end]
    low, high = start, end
    while low < high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        if arr[mid] < v:
            low = mid + 1
        else:
            high = mid
    return low

def solve(x, l, n, nn, p, ans, tn, c, s):
    if l != 6:
        p[0] += 1
        ans[0] = (ans[0] + (p[0] - x) // V - (p[0] < x) + X) % X
        for i in range(10):
            solve(x * 10 + i, l + 1, n, nn, p, ans, tn, c, s)
        return
    if x == nn:
        brute(x, 0, n, p, ans)
        return
    k = 0
    v = x
    while k <= 6 and v <= n:
        v *= 10
        k += 1
    k -= 1
    for i in range(k + 1):
        v2 = p[0] - x * tn[i]
        ans[0] = (ans[0] + (v2 // V - (v2 < 0) + X) * tn[i]) % X
        v_mod = (v2 % V + V) % V
        idx = lower_bound(s[k][i], 1, tn[i] + 1, v_mod)
        ans[0] = (ans[0] + tn[i] - (idx - 1) + 1) % X
    for i in range(k + 1):
        p[0] += tn[i]

# Constants
SZ = 1000000
V = 998244353
X = 1000000007

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    n = int(input_data)
    p = [0]
    ans = [0]
    tn = [1]
    for _ in range(1, 7):
        tn.append(tn[-1] * 10)
    c = [[0] * 7 for _ in range(7)]
    s = [[[0] * (SZ + 1) for _ in range(7)] for _ in range(7)]
    # Initialize s
    for k in range(7):
        p[0] = 0
        init(0, 0, k, p, c, s)
        for i in range(7):
            s[k][i][1:tn[i]+1] = sorted(s[k][i][1:tn[i]+1])
    p[0] = 0
    if p[0] == 0 and n < 1e6:
        for i in range(1, 10):
            brute(i, 1, n, p, ans)
    else:
        nn = n
        while nn >= 1e6:
            nn //= 10
        for i in range(1, 10):
            solve(i, 1, n, nn, p, ans, tn, c, s)
    result = (1 - ans[0]) * V % X
    print(result)

main()
